name: Al Hajar Geopark (aspiring UNESCO Global Geopark)
designation: Aspiring UNESCO Global Geopark (~5,400 km², 11 wilayats in Ad Dakhiliyah, South Al Batinah, North Ash Sharqiyah); dossier submitted to UNESCO Sept 2026, passed initial evaluation Oct 2026
note: Dossier/evaluation status from Muscat Daily headlines (21 Sep and 3 Oct 2026) - article bodies not retrievable

name: Coral Garden, Al Jabal Al Akhdar (Saiq Plateau)
designation: Site on the official Al Hajar Geopark map/booklet (Ministry of Heritage and Tourism)
note: Permian fossil corals (Saiq Fm), ~2,050 m near Al Aqur

name: Fish Fossils, Al Jabal Al Akhdar (Ash Shuraija/Al Sheif)
designation: Site on the official Al Hajar Geopark map/booklet (Ministry of Heritage and Tourism)

name: Bawshar (geosite)
designation: Geosite in the Ministry of Tourism 'Muscat Geoheritage' guide (30 Muscat geosites)
note: Only 4 of the guide's 30 sites are named in accessible sources (the 4th, Bandar Al Khairan, is a separate row)

name: Wadi Al Khoud
designation: Geosite in the Ministry of Tourism 'Muscat Geoheritage' guide (30 Muscat geosites)

name: Wadi Al Meeh
designation: Geosite in the Ministry of Tourism 'Muscat Geoheritage' guide (30 Muscat geosites)

name: Al Hajar Al Gharbi Starlight Reserve
designation: Starlight reserve, Royal Decree 40/2019; covers Jabal Shams high plateau; spans Ad Dakhiliyah, Ad Dhahirah, South Al Batinah
note: Related app entry jebel-shams (Jebel Shams and Wadi Nakhr) lies inside it but is not the reserve itself

name: Al Dhahirah Natural Reserve
designation: Nature reserve, Royal Decree 24/2024

name: Buraimi Oasis Natural Reserve
designation: Nature reserve, Royal Decree 25/2024

name: Khor Kharfot Archaeological Reserve
designation: Archaeological/natural reserve, Royal Decree 58/2021 (143.4 km²)

name: Musandam Natural National Park Reserve
designation: Natural national park reserve, Royal Decree 54/2022 (1,149.4 km²)
note: App's khor-ash-sham (Musandam fjord) is a feature likely within it but not the park itself

name: Al Jabal Al Gharbi Natural Reserve
designation: Nature reserve, Royal Decree 23/2024
